remarks:
Rare Lakefront In-Ground Pool! Wake up to breathtaking Lake Ontario views from your new home. This unique property features a private, gated, in-ground pool overlooking Lake Ontario, along with a spacious deck and patio—perfect for entertaining, relaxing, and enjoying spectacular sunsets and views of the Toronto skyline. Lake views are showcased from nearly every room, with an open-concept living and dining area and a private balcony overlooking the water for the master suite.  The pool provides safe swimming for adults and kids while enjoying the peaceful lakefront.  Gardeners will also enjoy the expansive backyard and the privacy this home provides.
Additional features include first-floor laundry, a partially finished basement, generously sized bedrooms, and an attached 2.5-car garage. For boating enthusiasts, Wilson Boatyard Marina is just minutes away. Fort Niagara is approximately 15 minutes away, while the Lewiston-Queenston Bridge is approximately 30 minutes away, offering convenient access to Toronto, Canada. 
Recent updates provide added peace of mind, including: - Appliances - new stove, new washer/dryer (2026) - Furnace (2024) - Water line to street (2024) - Sand pool filter (2024) - Hot water tank (2023) - Septic system (2022).  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a one-of-a-kind Lake Ontario waterfront property where spectacular views, an inground pool, and effortless resort-style living come together in one extraordinary home.
